title: The Quest HD
notes: The exact 2.0.4/build 8 IPA now reaches the menu, introduction, character creation, textured town and Bryl dialogue on an ARM64 Android 16 phone. Movement was not proved because input was attempted during dialogue; combat, audio, manual saves, sustained play and emulator disk states remain untested. The older launch-routing failure applied to an earlier build.

reviewedUserReports.notes: On a physical Android 16 ARM64 phone, the exact The Quest HD 2.0.4 (build 8) IPA reached the menu, introduction, character creation, textured town and Bryl dialogue without returning to the emulator library. Movement was not proved: the attempted input happened during NPC dialogue. Combat, audio, manual saves, sustained play and emulator disk states were not tested.
